title: The Convict
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office learns that Martin Nash, a new employee from Stamford, is a reformed convict who was imprisoned for insider trading. Michael confronts stereotypes about convicts and race by publicly defending Martin. Inspired by Martin's description of prison life, Michael attempts to improve office morale by instituting outdoor time, leading to mixed reactions. Michael also adopts a humorous 'Prison Mike' persona to teach the office a lesson about appreciating freedom, culminating in locking employees in a conference room before releasing them. Meanwhile, Jim has started a new relationship with Karen but is not ready to discuss it openly, and Andy seeks Jim's help to woo Pam with a playful country music approach.
